title: V03 Clip 22
shots: So, is Nvidia the next Cisco?
3D verdict stage: you face the CISCO and NVIDIA pedestals, camera pushes in
In its seat, yes. It's the main supplier of a historic build-out, more and more paid for with debt, and partly backed by its own guarantees.
chain links the two cubes: SAME SEAT yes, DEBT tag, GUARANTEES tag
In its price, no. You're not paying one hundred times profit.
the balance scale tips: Cisco's pan heavy with a 100x price, Nvidia's light; NO stamp
But here's the twist. Cisco holders waited because of what they paid. Nvidia holders would wait because of what the customers could no longer pay.
hourglass over Cisco: waited because of PRICE; camera slides to Nvidia: coins drain, customers can't pay
